title: WorkHarbor workspace manifest (workharbor.json), schema_version 1 and proposed schema_version 2
description: Language-neutral description of the manifest. schema_version 1 is the accepted form read today by the host agent resolver (apps/host_agent/internal/config/resolver.go) and scripts/check_repo.py: exactly four fields. schema_version 2 is PROPOSED by owner decision H77 (2026-10-17, wave 1a): the same four fields plus optional name, start_dir, human_shell, console_mode, shortcuts and project; the resolver rejects it until a separate, reviewed resolver change lands, which keeps the extension fail-closed. Strict JSON: UTF-8 without BOM, duplicate keys rejected, depth <= 128, size <= 65536 bytes for whr validate. Path values are exact native strings. Rules beyond JSON Schema, enforced by validators and frozen in contracts/workspace/vectors.json: schema_version must be the integer 1 or 2 (not 1.0), and any case variant of .git is refused as a path component (the resolver compares case-insensitively). The path pattern is exact-case and uses lookahead, so it documents the rule and is not executed by RE2; the positive and negative path vectors prove its equivalence with the Go checker. Defaults when a version 2 field is absent: start_dir '.', human_shell fish, console_mode herdr, shortcuts on (FR-047/FR-048/FR-049); the WorkHarbor agent-command shell is fixed to bash by policy and is not a field.

canonicalPath.description: Relative, slash-separated, no empty/./../.git component, no backslash, NUL, CR, LF, tab or glob characters; mirrors CanonicalPath in apps/host_agent/internal/config/path.go. Containment and symlink safety are filesystem checks, not schema checks.

bundles.description: Bundle attachments are deferred; the list must be empty.

start_dir.description: Workspace-relative starting directory; '.' is the workspace root. Existence is checked in the runtime before spawning, not here.

human_shell.description: Interactive human shell started by the console; default fish. Agent commands always run in bash by policy; that is not a field.

console_mode.description: herdr starts the terminal workspace manager; plain starts the shell directly. Default herdr.

shortcuts.description: on loads the shared BundleDock shell shortcuts layer; off does not. Default on.

url.description: Desired input only, never a pin: https without userinfo, or ssh (a user name before @ is admitted for ssh only). No query, fragment, whitespace, control or bidirectional characters; percent escapes must be well formed (checked by validators). whr never fetches it. Stricter than the resolver's origin check by design: scp-like addresses are not accepted here. Ports are 1 to 65535 and the path has no empty component (checked by validators).

path.description: projects_path + '/' + name, where name is the last path component of url with one trailing .git removed and matches [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; validators check containment against projects_path (the pattern cannot).

name.description: Suggested workspace name for 'ws create' (an input, not an identity). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-64 characters, no leading or trailing hyphen; the grammar is to match the future owner-API workspace name rule and changes only together with it.
